product.name: Conductor
promise: Controllers do the work. The operator decides what matters.
product.lede: Conductor coordinates coding-agent sessions across the repositories of one organization. One background session, conductor, reads every repository, starts one controller session per repository and takes the routine decisions those controllers raise; architectural decisions go to the operator. The conductor CLI reads the repositories, keeps the records and guards the sessions.
product.meta: Rust CLI · Claude Code sessions · specified in ESS · Apache-2.0

sections.title: One loop over every repository.
sections.lede: Conductor keeps only its own records: decisions, dispatches, goals, controllers, messages, guard verdicts and snapshots. Every other fact stays with the tool that owns it, and conductor never edits another repository.

items.title: One snapshot of every repository
items.description: conductor snapshot start-snapshot runs five collectors: git state, pull requests and main CI, open planning blockers, specification status and live sessions. A snapshot completes only when all five answered.

items.title: Decisions by class
items.description: Conductor takes and records routine class-C decisions, escalates class O to the operator and lists class H for the operator's hands. The CLI refuses a class-O or class-H decision recorded as conductor's.

items.title: A guard on every controller
items.description: A PreToolUse hook denies a controller's file edits outside its repository and its messages to anyone but conductor. It catches mistakes; it is not a sandbox.

items.title: A watch between cycles
items.description: conductor watch run wakes conductor when a session exits, hits a usage limit or fills its context, when main CI turns red or green, or when disk runs low.

items.title: Starting a controller's session from the CLI
items.description: controller start-controller records the controller only; the conductor session starts the harness session itself.

items.title: An operating-system sandbox for Bash
items.description: The guard reads a Bash command line but does not bound where it writes. A sandbox that does is planned.

sections.title: Sense, decide, dispatch, record.
sections.lede: A cycle runs on the instance's cadence, once a day with the operator brief, and whenever a controller reports. The CLI senses and records; the session compares, decides and dispatches.

sections.title: Early. Here is exactly what exists.
sections.lede: Shipped means code on main today, held by a test. Planned means on the plan only. Nothing is released yet. Generated by conductor-docs.

tools.name: AEP
tools.description: Each repository's planning store. Controllers plan and deliver through it; conductor's blockers collector reads its open decision blockers.

tools.name: Eventlog
tools.description: The event store under conductor's records: one stream per record in an eventlog tree store.

tools.name: Worktree
tools.description: Managed worktrees beside each checkout. The guard treats them as the repository's own; the dashboard reads their cleanup dry-runs.

tools.name: Gates
tools.description: Common security and privacy checks. Conductor's own gate scans every tracked file with them.
